negative_controls.failure_mode: Reject a compliant certificate when optional provenance is missing, or accept tampered/foreign extras.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Enforce an exact hard-coded list of eight critical artifact keys or trust declared optional metadata without digest verification.
negative_controls.expected: Seven required/controlled artifacts pass; recognized extras pass; missing mandatory, changed SHA and foreign entries fail closed.
negative_controls.observed: Test passed on exact material HEAD 937137fb911f537c14f9181cc862688d74ecb136

negative_controls.failure_mode: Valid targeted remediation with two required records is refused, or systemic/mixed certificates omit lineage.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Require audit_escape_closure and learning_closure for all previous independent rejections regardless of remediation_mode.
negative_controls.procedure: Run pytest -q tests/test_session_review_packet.py -k critical_inventory_accepts_seven_real_stage_a_artifacts_and_known_extensions against original and patched modules (old must fail; new must pass).
negative_controls.expected: Targeted with audit_remediation+audit_source_result passes; missing either rejects; systemic/mixed fail without escape+learning, pass with both; tampered digest rejects.
negative_controls.observed: Original module test exit 1 due to inventory error; patched exact material 23 tests passed. Negative log sha256 c1f8e2bd02593fbd4ef388c0f8b9b181258e71ccc9e0a8b0e51086dba9f92c7d

risk_surfaces.reason: Binding of issue, base, HEAD and merge preview in package and certificate is checked by fail-closed parsers.
Bootstrap documentation must not claim production trust or Stage B activation by an unmerged PR.
Optional provenance and recognized remediation artefacts must remain authenticated without false refusal.
Remediation mode controls the mandatory critical-certificate artifact inventory.
